items.difficulty_reason: Abhyankar 引理，statement 需要 Remark 引入的记号（K_1/K、A_1 与 B_1 的局部化、极大理想 m_i、m_ij），证明三层归约、每层都做实：先附加 u 的 e 次根把 u 假设成 e 次幂（要检验有限可分、局部化有限 étale）；再把 K_1 换成由 π 的 e 次根生成的子域并证明可借「形式光滑可上推」把结论传回；最后一段真正做计算——把 π_B 写成单位乘 e 次幂，说明附加两根之商使扩张有限 étale，再用分歧指数的乘性与剩余域的塔算出指数为 1 且剩余域扩张可分，用判别法收尾。5 处引用全在同章（含 statement 引用 Remark 与最后一句复用判别法），承重演算均在 span 内。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-abhyankar (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 34036-34048

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction that lets one assume the unit relating the two uniformizers is an e-th power by passing to a finite etale extension, the passage to the subfield generated by the root of the uniformizer, and the final case where the extension of the larger rings is finite etale so that both ramification index and residue field behave (source lines 34050-34135)
